title: About Petdex: Animated pets for your coding agents | Petdex
description: Petdex is an open-source gallery of animated pets for coding agents like ChatGPT (Codex), Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenCode. Browse the catalog, install with one command, or submit your own.
text: What is a coding agent pet? A pet is a small animated pixel companion for your coding agent. Each pet ships as a single pet.json describing 9 states (idle, working, sleeping, etc.) plus a horizontal spritesheet. Your agent picks the right state automatically based on what you're doing in your session.
